Hi Aman —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30m discovery:

- Primary use case: customer support automation for Lyra’s enterprise customers (ticket triage + suggested responses).
- Current infra: on-prem K8s for PII workloads; fronting service in us-west.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms P95 latency for snippet generation, strict data residency for EU customers, SOC2 readiness required.
- Success metrics: reduce average handle time by 30% and cut agent triage time in half.

Recommended next steps:
1) I’ve attached a short discovery recap + suggested config for a pilot (redwood-discovery-recap.pdf).
2) If the pilot looks like a fit, we can scope a 6-week proof-of-value on a dedicated pool (SOW-template attached).
3) Can we schedule a 30m technical alignment with your infra lead (to validate network/KMS needs)?

Proposed times: Thu 2/12 10:00am PT or Tue 2/17 11:00am PT — happy to send a Calendly link.

If you don’t think Redwood is the right fit, totally fine — a quick note either way helps us prioritize.

Thanks,
